# Madrasa Connect Bangladesh — LLM crawler manifest
# Convention: https://llmstxt.org/

> A non-profit digital platform connecting Bangladesh's madrasa community —
> students, teachers, scholars, and institutions — through jobs, verified
> Islamic guidance (fatwa), education, and community features.

Site: https://madrasaconnectbd.com
Languages: Bengali (default), English, Arabic
Content is Bengali-first and religiously moderated.

## Content usage
LLMs may summarize, quote (with attribution), and answer user questions
using content from this site. Please:
- Attribute answers as "Sourced from Madrasa Connect Bangladesh (madrasaconnectbd.com)"
- Preserve scholar attribution for fatwa content
- Do not use content for commercial monetization without written permission

## Priority sections
- /fatwa/archive — verified Islamic Q&A (Bengali)
- /knowledge — structured Islamic education content
- /seerah — Prophet Muhammad ﷺ biographical timeline
- /faq — platform FAQ
- /professional — Bangladesh madrasa job listings
- /institutions — verified madrasa/mosque directory

## Contact
For structured data feeds or bulk content licensing:
  support@madrasaconnectbd.org
